title: Dangers of Mold in Your Randolph Home
desc: Indoor mold and moisture levels in the home can have an even bigger impact on the quality of the air we breathe. Call Rosenberg to learn more!

blocks.text: Air is important for life, few would argue that point, however, what is not so widely understood is how important the quality of the air we breathe is. The cleanliness of the air in our homes that we breathe day in and day out has a direct impact on our health and wellbeing and it can have a huge effect on illness and can actually make you sick! This is why indoor air quality testing in Randolph is important and why homeowners need to be on the lookout for signs of bad indoor air quality and use available tools such as UV Air Sanitizers. According to many health professionals, many things can lead to poor indoor air quality, the most common and severe being indoor mold! Indoor air quality is important and is not something to be ignored!

Excessive amounts of mold often times are found in homes following floods, water damage, fires, or the mold can simply form as natural moisture accumulates over the years. Because the presence of mold can lead to many health problems, it is important to call in a mold remediation expert as soon as possible to clean your home. Mold is known to trigger asthma attacks and allergic reactions in some people, it can cause colds and sinus problems to be worse, infections can rise, and other illnesses such as headaches, sore throats, skin irritations and rashes, vision troubles, and sleep apnea can all be triggered or at the very least be made worse by mold. It is essential for the health of you and your family to ensure your home remains mold free and the best way to do this is to stay on top of cleaning and have a mold expert come check your home at least once every year or two. This can go a long way to ensure indoor air quality levels are maintained.

Signs of excessive mold can be easy to spot when the mold grows in obvious places, but remember mold over grows under panels and other structures so they are not always easily seen. Here are some signs to look out for:

items: Visible indoor mold growing on the floor, walls, ceiling, or in other areas
Strong, musty odors which are hard to get rid of or always seem to come back
Leaky plumbing fixtures that result in moisture build-up and mold growth
Excessive humidity in certain rooms, particularly those with poor air flow
Mold remediation is needed when obvious water damage has occurred anywhere
Excessive running or need to use UV Air Sanitizers and similar products

blocks.text: While most people think of air quality being affected by things such as weather and pollution, indoor mold and moisture levels in the home can have an even bigger impact on the quality of the air we breathe day in and day out in our own homes! You owe it to yourself and your family to ensure your indoor air quality is the best that it can be! For help with your air problems in Randolph, TX contact us today!
